attachment.choose: Button that opens a file picker, shown when no file is chosen.
attachment.replace: Button that opens a file picker, shown when a file is already chosen.
attachment.pickTitle: Title of the operating system file dialog.
attachment.fromDisk: {{path}} is a file path. Tooltip over a file name.
attachment.tooLarge: {{size}}, {{limit}}, {{proxyLimit}} and {{desktopLimit}} are file sizes such as 4.5 MB.
attachment.proxyTooLarge: {{proxyLimit}} is a file size such as 4.5 MB. CLI is the command-line tool.
